correctness.rationale: The tame Kummer cover has six branch points and genus four; regular differential basis U=dx/y,H=dx/y^2,W=x dx/y^2,J=x^2 dx/y^2 is justified by valuations at ramification points and infinity. Cartier on this basis is C(U)=V=J+sqrt(a)W+sqrt(b)H, C(W)=U, C(H)=C(J)=0, C(V)=a^(1/4)U. Consequently image dimension two always; restriction to span(U,V) invertible for a!=0, nilpotent of length three for a=0. The cubic coefficient survives x-translation in characteristic two and scales by u^(-2); squarefree open intersects both strata, so the locus is nonempty smooth divisor in marked monic parameters. Verified full script matrix logic and symbolic semilinearity; finite GF4 tests corroborate but are not used as proof.
